lines.text: Amma, I followed your recipe exactly.
Recipe? What recipe? You don't measure. You listen to the pan.
When the cumin talks back, it's ready.
Your nani never measured. I never measured. You will not measure.
And call your father. He thinks you're angry with him. Silly man.
Yes, I'm eating. Amma says hi.
